channel.title: Climate Errata: ASOS
channel.description: Register entries and discussions about Automated Surface Observing System

item.title: [Published (preprint)] ASOS wind sensors (sonic swap 2005–09; commissioning)
item.description: US steps of −6.5% (sonic) and −9% (commissioning) remove most US 1988–2010 stilling; global 1978–2010 decline (Zeng method) −2.7 → −1.9 %/decade; NH (HadISD design) −24%

item.title: [No error found] ASOS dew-point sensor swap (DTS1, 2002–06)
item.description: Transient drift reset; no lasting step

item.title: [Published (preprint)] Zeng et al. 2019 NCC; Monerie et al. 2026 Clim Dyn (wind stilling)
item.description: ASOS sensor steps explain most of the North American decline and about 30% of the global 1978–2010 decline
